scope.flow: TokenWrapper.transferFrom allowance-based token transfer and Transfer event emission
scope.environment: Ethereum ERC-20 TokenWrapper contract and off-chain event consumers

entities.name: Block explorers, wallets, indexers and event-listening protocols

statements.text: A user or contract calls transferFrom to move tokens on behalf of another address using an allowance.
The from parameter identifies the actual token holder whose balance is debited by the transfer.
The spender invokes transferFrom(from, to, amount) on TokenWrapper.
TokenWrapper emits the Transfer event for the transferFrom operation.
The Transfer event emission substitutes msg.sender (the spender) for the from parameter as the source address.
The emitted Transfer event records the spender as the source rather than the actual token holder, creating a permanent incorrect on-chain event record.
Block explorers and wallet applications display the operator or router contract as the originating address, so users do not see their TokenWrapper transfers in their sent transaction history.
Off-chain indexing systems and analytics attribute TokenWrapper activity to router contracts and operators rather than the actual users.
Protocols listening to Transfer events for accounting, access control, referral or rewards incorrectly credit activity to operator contracts rather than users.
The Transfer event emitted by transferFrom must report the from parameter, the token holder whose balance decreases, as the source address.
Internal _balanceOf accounting is updated correctly and actual token balances reflect the proper transfer; the defect is confined to event emission.

ambiguities: Report does not state whether the spender is authorized or unauthorized; the flaw affects every transferFrom call regardless of caller legitimacy.
Tax-reporting and compliance failures are claimed but not included as separate impacts due to the four-impact limit.
No concrete transaction or numeric event values are supplied; the wrong-sender outcome is described as inherent to every transferFrom call.
